feeds.title: Go Vegan World Blog
feeds.description: 'The greatest problem on earth today is the notion that some lives matter less than others. We imagine that non-human lives hardly matter at all. We live as though our difference from other species entitles us to use them and that they exist for our benefit. This view is not only inaccurate, it is unethical.' Sandra Higgins, MSc Couns Psych, MBPsS, Campaign Director

feeds.title: Fully Free Ireland Blog
feeds.description: Fully Free is a small family business run by Suzanne and her husband, Gábor. Suzanne's creativity, and competent marketing, and sales experience complement Gábor's passion and life-long devotion to quality food. Fully Free tries to make everyday meals simpler and tastier with healthy plant-based foods. On the other hand, they want to take a stand for a lifestyle that is important to them and to future generations.

feeds.title: The Taste » Vegan Recipe
feeds.description: We want TheTaste to be a culinary kaleidoscope to champion every taste, food, wine, cocktail, whiskey, etc. We are delighted to be part of such a creative and fast-moving industry and are very passionate about sharing with you our unique journey around Ireland to find the best culinary hotspots. In the Vegan recipe, section get to know about our mouthwatering meat-free vegetarian and vegan recipes.

feeds.title: Diced and Spiced
feeds.description: Diced & Spiced is the brainchild of Daniel, with some occasional input from me, Suzanne. On this website, we hope to share some of the foods we eat regularly. These include easy junk food recipes, wholefood plant-based recipes, and of course, our more exotic 'nation of the month' recipes, which often require a trip to the local ethnic market.

feeds.title: Vegan Sustainability Magazine
feeds.description: Vegan Sustainability Magazine is a free, online, quarterly magazine for vegans and non-vegans worldwide who are interested in the environment and sustainability. Read our latest articles to stay updated with information about agriculture, veganism, ecology, and much more.

feeds.title: Dublin VegFest
feeds.description: We are Dublin Vegfest - a small dedicated group of people passionate about vegan living. The dream for Dublin Vegfest started some years ago when we saw the need to showcase the beneficial, brilliant, and beautiful vegan lifestyle in Ireland. Using our backgrounds in organizing vegan events, co-ops, and training we decided to host Dublin Vegfest. We are inspired by other vegan festivals worldwide and aim to make Dublin Vegfest an important event in the calendar of anyone curious about great ethical food, vegan options, community, health, and having the craic.

feeds.title: Theirishvegan.ie
feeds.description: My name is Bronwyn Slater and I've been active in the vegan community in Ireland since 2011 - the year I went vegan. The Irish Vegan has been an information resource for vegans in Ireland (North and South) since 2012.
